title: Check chart startup without a captured calendar
description: Re-run the 8 original 321 tasks on the exact jvmcontract binary that decided their startup-qualified companions. Keep both historical revisions, every original guard, observer, independent JVM grid, bound and deadline. Test that the native checker identifies the first ambient startup query when no initializer observation is supplied.
expected: Every original task runs to the checker and remains open at java.util.TimeZone.getDefault without an observed initializer or calendar profile. An unexpected decision, different binary, missing task or unrelated refusal fails this negative control. The original unresolved receipts are collected for comparison.

steps.name: Run the original strict claims at their frozen bounds
steps.run:
status=0
JVMCONTRACT_SOLVER=bitwuzla-finite JVMCONTRACT_BITWUZLA="${JVMCONTRACT_BITWUZLA:-$HOME/tools/bitwuzla/current}" python3 examples/tools/build.py 321 --tasks lower-parent,lower-fix,upper-parent,upper-fix,populated-lower-parent,populated-upper-parent,populated-lower-fix,populated-upper-fix --checker-seconds 30 || status=$?
test "$status" -eq 1

steps.name: Verify every refusal on the same checker and collect the original receipts
steps.run:
python3 -c 'import json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
folder, tasks, method, site, binary, tree = sys.argv[1:]
job = os.environ['"'"'VERIFY_JOB_ID'"'"']
for task in tasks.split('"'"','"'"'):
    runs = []
    for path in (Path(folder) / '"'"'receipts'"'"' / task / '"'"'executions'"'"').glob('"'"'*/attempt.json'"'"'):
        attempt = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
        if attempt.get('"'"'job'"'"') == job:
            runs.append((path, attempt))
    [(path, attempt)] = runs
    assert attempt['"'"'checker'"'"']['"'"'jvmcontract'"'"'] == binary and attempt['"'"'checker'"'"']['"'"'libTree'"'"'] == tree
    assert attempt['"'"'lastCompletedStage'"'"'] == '"'"'receipt-published'"'"' and attempt['"'"'budget'"'"'] == {'"'"'checkerSeconds'"'"': 30}
    assert '"'"'--observed-initializer'"'"' not in attempt['"'"'argv'"'"'] and '"'"'--gaps'"'"' in attempt['"'"'argv'"'"']
    [outcome] = json.loads((path.parent / '"'"'checker.json'"'"').read_bytes())['"'"'outcomes'"'"']
    assert outcome['"'"'verdict'"'"'] == '"'"'unverifiable'"'"' and outcome['"'"'stated'"'"']['"'"'gap_mode'"'"'] == '"'"'strict'"'"'
    assert method in attempt['"'"'firstBlocker'"'"'] and site in attempt['"'"'firstBlocker'"'"'], (task, attempt['"'"'firstBlocker'"'"'])
    assert not any(a.get('"'"'id'"'"', '"'"''"'"').startswith(('"'"'observed-calendar:'"'"', '"'"'observed-initializer:'"'"')) for a in outcome['"'"'stated'"'"']['"'"'assumptions'"'"'])
    receipt = json.loads((Path(folder) / attempt['"'"'receipt'"'"']).read_bytes())
    assert receipt['"'"'conclusion'"'"']['"'"'status'"'"'] == '"'"'unresolved'"'"' and receipt['"'"'claim'"'"']['"'"'id'"'"'] == attempt['"'"'preparedClaim'"'"']
    print(task, '"'"'open at'"'"', method)
' examples/321-jfreechart-empty-series-range lower-parent,lower-fix,upper-parent,upper-fix,populated-lower-parent,populated-upper-parent,populated-lower-fix,populated-upper-fix java.util.TimeZone.getDefault 'org.jfree.data.time.RegularTimePeriod.<clinit>' bd14a0af15e362235ae53157abd1f7fe7fe0113af560eccaf160ce9483efa5af 29e34d8802decff2c4c91717db160d151b315c9c
